mechanism_narrative: A surge in housing starts (HOUST) above 1200 units signals increased consumer confidence, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
evidence_refs: fact:historical correlation between HOUST and consumer confidence indices
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 50% of instances when HOUST > 1200, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) below 1% indicates accommodative monetary policy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns when FEDFUNDS < 1% are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When unemployment rate (UNRATE) drops below 4.2% and payroll employment (PAYEMS) growth exceeds 200k, a strong labor market drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
evidence_refs: fact:historical labor market indicators and SPX performance
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 40% of instances when both conditions are met, or Rank IC < 0.01 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production (INDPRO) growth above 2% signals increased economic activity, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 45% of instances when INDPRO growth > 2%, or Rank IC < 0.025 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Real disposable personal income (RSAFS) growth below -1% indicates decreased consumer spending power, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
evidence_refs: fact:historical correlation between RSAFS and consumer spending
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5d returns in > 55% of instances when RSAFS growth < -1%, or Rank IC < 0.015 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) exceeds 2% and CPI (CPIAUCSL) growth is above 3%, a tightening monetary cycle with rising inflation leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 50% of instances when both conditions are met, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Always-on: payroll employment (PAYEMS) growth is a persistent driver of positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days, regardless of other macro conditions.
evidence_refs: fact:historical labor market indicators and SPX performance
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.035 over any 2-year rolling window, or 60-day forward returns are not significantly correlated with PAYEMS growth (p > 0.1).

mechanism_narrative: GDP (GDPC1) growth above 3% signals robust economic activity, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, but only during mid-cycle expansions.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 40% of instances when GDPC1 growth > 3% during mid-cycle, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.
